graphEvents.label: Q5 ranked exact edits that make the concise format the default
A third tier cannot capture a release that carries breaking changes

label: A third tier cannot capture the target entry: v4.0.1.0 carries two inline Breaking markers, and the selection rule routes any breaking change to Expanded regardless of count, so a many-change non-breaking tier would still bypass it; the fix must redefine what Expanded contains, not re-route which releases reach it.

Redefining Expanded needs six edit intents across five files; a third tier needs all of those plus a retiering pass across roughly ten mirror sites, so redefinition is the minimal route and the ranked list introduces no tier name.

Length authority transfers at the calibration sentence under the length table, not only at the exemplar precedence clause: template line 212 makes every ceiling sit at or above what the exemplar does, so adding a ceiling without editing it adds another ceiling calibrated upward; Rank 1 must include lines 31 and 212 together or it fails.

The Expanded skeleton has no slot where a folded-fixes block could go: its topical body is one item template followed by a second item template, so a writer obeying the skeleton cannot build a grouped list even if the Drop-list wording permitted it; the fold rule needs a skeleton slot, not only a bullet rewrite.

Section-ordered upgrade notes need three coordinated edits plus one new attribution convention; the phrase 'in section order' already exists in both command YAMLs but only for glance bullets, which lowers the edit cost, while the retirement-to-replacement attribution rule does not exist and is the actual blocker.

The spec-line contradiction resolves one way at zero cost: SKILL.md validation check 4 tests the spec-folder blockquote for presence only, never shape, so deleting the Level suffix at two template sites and one SKILL.md site breaks no check and leaves the Drop-list line untouched.

Filter-first selection is four edits, and the operative one is the command YAML, not the template: in autonomous mode the SELECT CONTENT block is the text that runs, so editing only the template changes nothing about generated output.

At-a-glance section tagging is a precondition rather than an improvement: it must be authored into four sites before any order check exists, it buys no concision, and it imposes a small reader-facing cost on compact entries, so it ranks below every item that changes output.

The exemplar-relative domain escape is removable for free because the first half of the same bullet already states the correct test; deleting the escape losses no guidance and removes the last place a writer is told a big release earns more sections.

The completion report scores volume while the body rules forbid it: the result template prints Files Tracked from files_changed_count, a file-inventory metric the omission rules ban from prose; replacing it with an H4-item count inverts the incentive in two lines.

Two tempting edits must be refused because both would force the third tier this iteration eliminated: the SKILL.md success criterion stays true once Expanded is redefined, and the command doc is a router that forbids inventing visible wording.

The validator addition is two insertion points and five checks, all warning severity: module constants beside CHANGELOG_ENTRY_NAME and one call beside validate_changelog_omissions in the changelog dispatch branch; the Level check must be applied to the blockquote rather than by unmasking it, because unmasking would fire the internal-id regex on every legitimate packet number a spec line carries.

The redefinition has exactly one unavoidable cost: a 240-line body ceiling passes the target entry at 196 lines and fails the 535-line exemplar, so the exemplar and the ceiling cannot both be canonical; that is an operator decision, not an edit.

Every ranked site was re-read in the current working tree after the other session's changes: ROUTER.md keeps its line count at 138 and its cited regions at 23 and 33/135-137, and every cited validate_document.py region resolved at its prior line number after the 2ff74ac003 commit.
No ceiling may ship ahead of the exemplar decision, because the exemplar fails every total ceiling the target format needs and strict validation runs over the tree.
No fold heuristic and no at-a-glance order check may ship before the template supplies the canonical fold heading and the bullet section tag, because both checks would be unfalsifiable without them.

Re-measuring the target artifact reorganized the iteration: one grep for Breaking inverted the architecture choice that iterations 2-4 were converging on, which no read of the input files would have produced.
